verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only single-item mail actions (open/scan, forward, shred, pickup scheduling) performed one at a time via app/portal; there is no mention of bulk/batch operations across many mail items, no API/automation interface (openapi and llms.txt probes both 404), and no bulk-action UI described. missing for 10: bulk selection/action UI for multiple mail items, any API or automation endpoint, evidence of batch processing across many pieces of mail.
